name: second-brain
description: Create, adopt, audit, and improve domain-focused AI agents with persistent knowledge files. Full lifecycle: operate (load the single-sourced protocol every agent bootstraps), create via interview, adopt hand-rolled agents, audit consistency/freshness/loop health/link graph, improve against gold-standard patterns, add repeatable workflows, wrap working sessions (transcript-verified persistence check). Five self-reinforcement loops (corrections, discoveries, custodian, contradictions, process retrospection), plus a lateral knowledge graph: link grammar, inert-reference conversion, and graph health checks.
